scholarships.title: AUF Virtual Mobility Grant for International Distance Degree Programmes (FOAD/IFIC call 2026/27)
scholarships.official_source: Agence universitaire de la Francophonie (AUF) / Institut de la Formation a Distance de la Francophonie (IFIC)

eligibility: Francophone student (etudiant francophone) who does not have to leave their country of residence
Meritorious student, or a student with limited resources
Enrolled in one of the international distance degree programmes in the AUF catalogue
Enrolment in a programme delivered by an AUF member institution
existing.eligibility_summary: Francophone students who are high-achieving or have limited resources, enrolling in one of more than 150 international distance degree programmes run by AUF member institutions in 13 countries.
benefits: Virtual international mobility allowance in the form of partial reimbursement of enrolment fees
Support from application to diploma, including follow-up of the course and organisation of exams and defences
Free access to AUF offices worldwide during the whole process
coverage: Partial enrolment-fee coverage ('prise en charge partielle des frais d'inscription')
Free access to AUF offices worldwide throughout the application, study, exam and defence process
Mentoring and administrative follow-up from application through to graduation, including the organisation of exams and thesis defences
requirements: Apply to one of the international distance degree programmes listed in the AUF catalogue
Meet the entry requirements of the delivering member institution
Submit through the AUF calls-for-applications platform before the intake deadline
documents: The call page does not itemise the document list; applicants follow the admission requirements of the delivering institution
Programme-specific admission documents requested by the chosen AUF member institution
application_method: Consult the catalogue of more than 150 international distance degree programmes
Apply through the AUF calls-for-applications platform, where applicants also create an account
existing.selection_notes: Support targets students who are the most deserving or who have limited resources. Award volume is not published.
existing.best_fit: Francophone students in Africa, the Arab Maghreb and other AUF member countries who want an international distance degree without relocating and need help with enrolment fees.
existing.notes: The AUF network's membership is concentrated in Africa, with a significant Arab Maghreb presence, so the pool spans several regions even though the eligibility rule is linguistic rather than national. Only partial enrolment fees are covered, so this is not a full scholarship.
existing.duration: Duration of the chosen distance degree programme, from licence to doctorat
existing.application_period: The 2026/27 call opened on 7 April 2026 and closed on 14 September 2026 at 23:59 Europe/Paris. It had two intake deadlines: 9 June 2026 for programmes starting September or October 2026, and 14 September 2026 for programmes starting January or February 2027.
existing.deadline_display: 14 September 2026 at 23:59 for programmes starting January/February 2027; 9 June 2026 for programmes starting September/October 2026
